text:
Aisha: heads-up — we're getting a surge of 429s on the rerank lane in eu-west starting ~08:12 UTC, embeddings lane fine so far.
Tom: on it, can you paste a sample of the client error? 429 vs 503?
Aisha: mostly 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, plus some queue_timeout from the router. snippet: ```2026-03-18T08:12:34Z rerank-service ERROR request_id=abc123 code=429 lane=rerank eu-west queue_len=48```.
Marco: queue_len 48 — that's above our admission control threshold. Are rerank requests not getting rerouted to the embed/fallback lane?
Aisha: looks like routing rules prefer rerank variants; fallback disabled for some customers due to accuracy constraints.
Tom: hmm. Is the rerank lane on the smaller GPUs (a2) after last week's provisioning change? I remember we moved some capacity to cheaper T4-like instances for embeddings.
Li: rerank lane uses p4s in eu-west-primary and a small dedicated pool of a10g for overflow. Embeddings use burst pool on mixed T4s.
Marco: maybe the p4 pool has a transient network issue — packets to the KV-cache layer timing out causes long service time, so queue builds up. Any increased network retransmits in the fabric?
Aisha: saw a spike in socket retransmits on p4-32-03 around the same time: if the runtime is waiting on KV we get head-of-line blocking.
Tom: OK, immediate mitigations:
- lower rerank admission limit by 30% (soft)
- enable cross-lane reroute to embed-rerank-approx for non-SLA tenants
- increase p4 pool autoscale by 2 nodes (if quota allows)
Can someone flip the config?
Marco: I'll toggle the soft admission limit and enable cross-lane for tagged non-sensitives. Doing now.
ops-bot: action=update_config user=Marco path=/routing/tiers/rerank/admission soft_limit=0.7 -> queued
SRE-Bot: autoscale_request queued for cluster eu-west-pool-p4 primary. current_replicas=6 target=8 reason="rerank_lp_spike"
Li: side-note — cross-lane reroute increases mismatch risk; we should annotate metrics to track quality regression (NDCG drop). I'll add a short-lived eval hook.
Aisha: config done — seeing immediate drop in client 429s but tail latency for rerank requests increased ~40ms as some are now routed to embed-approx.
Tom: good. Can we also throttle noisy customers at API gateway level? Add per-key fairshare instead of flat throttles.
Marco: yes, lifting per-key dynamic token bucket to enforce fairshare. policy patch: ```patch: /gateway/throttles -> per_key=true mode=fairshare window=60s```
Aisha: after changes, queue_len back to ~6 on rerank lane, retransmits trending down. Still keeping watch for 30m.
Li: follow-up items: add metric lane_saturation (0-1), emit event when >0.8 for >2m; create dashboard with cross-lane skew and NDCG.
Tom: and file a CAPEX note — our current autoscale headroom in eu-west is tight; need to discuss next-week provisioning to avoid repeated spillovers.
Aisha: thanks. tagging @SRE-rotation for postmortem if this recurs. :thumbsup:
SRE-Bot: incident_note created id=INC-20260318-01 owner=Marco severity=low impact=rerank-degraded mitigation=route+throttle
